thread_title: ВЕРО — регистрация и единый вход в платформу
format: Visible user and assistant text, commentary/final replies and available user image attachments. Readable export, not a native chat import.
limitations: Snapshot covers messages present at export time; later replies in this export task are not included.
Referenced documents beyond included original ZIP and images are not automatically copied.
Runtime account state, live sessions, GitHub/mos.ru connections and in-memory demo data are not transferred.
Historic assistant proposals may be superseded; use docs/PRODUCT.md and docs/HANDOFF.md for current decisions.
